message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is a “flexible” card: it can count as either **1** or **11**, whichever is more advantageous to the hand.  

- **If counting the Ace as 11 keeps the total ≤ 21, it is treated as 11.**  
- **If counting it as 11 would cause the hand to bust (> 21), the Ace automatically reverts to 1.**  

Thus, a hand with an Ace and a 9 can be worth 20 (Ace = 11) or 10 (Ace = 1), depending on what gives the best score without exceeding 21. If you have two Aces, one is usually counted as 11 and the other as 1 (so the pair totals 12). This flexibility is what makes the Ace the most valuable card in Blackjack.
